current_episode.title: S01 EP2 - Balancing AI and human judgement in IC, with Amanda Atkinson

guest.titre: Communication and Culture Leader, Internal Comms Person
guest.bio_context: Amanda has built her career in internal comms across several industries and has always sought ways to leverage technology and automation. She spent seven years at Salesforce leading internal comms for EMEA, where she developed a tech-driven mindset. She describes herself as an AI intrepid explorer, excited about exploring AI applications while maintaining honest acknowledgment of the learning curve ahead.

context.real_quote: Where I start with AI, I find myself just getting a mess. Where I start with my own work and then use AI to enhance and challenge, that's where it works best for me.

pending_qa.q: What framework does Amanda recommend for internal communicators learning about AI?
pending_qa.r: Amanda recommends the Anthropic AI Fluency course, which is free and features a framework with four Ds: direction, diligence, delegation, and discernment. She highlights discernment as the most important element. She also emphasizes remembering that AI is exciting and must be embraced, but internal communicators should not forget their own humanity and expert value, as those are not going anywhere.
